description: One draft with everything needed to iterate on it: text, media, the post it quotes, schedule state, the reviewer's per-axis breakdown, the score before the last rewrite, and its earlier versions (newest first). FREE. Each version has a version_id — pass it to revise_content_draft action:"restore" to bring that text back (e.g. "the first hook was better"). locked:true means it is already scheduled or live: do not try to change it; tell the user where to change it (locked_reason).
name: get_content_draft
title: Read one draft in full
